caveats: Comparative national exposure, not a local air-quality reading.
criteria.description: National population-weighted modelled exposure to fine particulate matter.
criteria.interpretation: Lower exposure receives a higher 1-10 health-band score.
quality_limitations: Modelled population-weighted estimate; not local regulatory monitoring.

caveats: Legal classification and reporting capacity vary by country.
criteria.description: Intentional homicides per 100,000 people; it does not represent all crime.
criteria.interpretation: Lower homicide rates receive a higher 1-10 risk-band score.
quality_limitations: Latest country reference years differ and the measure covers homicide only.

caveats: Not a precise cost-of-living ranking and not city- or household-specific.
criteria.description: A broad national household-consumption price-level band relative to United States = 100.
criteria.interpretation: Lower broad relative-cost bands receive higher 1-10 scores; equal bands are genuine ties.
quality_limitations: Derived from PPP and official exchange-rate inputs and intentionally scored in broad bands.

caveats: Measures laws, not lived safety, enforcement, social norms, or outcomes.
criteria.description: Women, Business and the Law legal-framework economy index measuring de jure equality.
criteria.interpretation: Higher legal-framework scores receive higher 1-10 equality-band scores.
quality_limitations: A national de jure framework indicator cannot establish individual lived experience.

caveats: Experimental and not a complete measure of infrastructure.
criteria.description: Experimental equal-weight composite of internet use, fixed broadband, and trade/transport infrastructure quality.
criteria.interpretation: Higher composite values receive higher 1-10 readiness-band scores.
quality_limitations: Only three components with mixed reference years; omits housing, energy, transit, resilience, and local access.

caveats: Perception-based national aggregate; it does not directly measure crime, democracy, or immigration policy.
criteria.description: Perception-based estimate of political stability and absence of violence or terrorism.
criteria.interpretation: Higher estimates receive higher broad-band scores; published uncertainty is retained.
quality_limitations: Uncertainty intervals can overlap, so precise country ranks are not claimed.

caveats: Perception-based national aggregate; it is not an individual legal-outcome prediction.
criteria.description: Perception-based estimate of confidence in and adherence to the rules of society.
criteria.interpretation: Higher estimates receive higher broad-band scores; published uncertainty is retained.
quality_limitations: Uncertainty intervals can overlap and the measure may correlate strongly with political stability.

caveats: Not a measure of acceptance, integration quality, government support, or visa accessibility.
criteria.description: International migrant stock as a share of the national population.
criteria.interpretation: Higher scores mean more established immigrant presence for users who value that property; they do not mean universal country quality.
quality_limitations: Publisher definitions may combine country-of-birth and citizenship concepts and may include estimates.

caveats: Latest official value is from 2021 and fails the release freshness threshold.
criteria.description: Population-level universal health coverage service-coverage index.
criteria.interpretation: Available for diagnostics only; it never contributes to normal rankings.
quality_limitations: Population-level coverage does not describe expat access, quality, waiting time, or individual affordability.

caveats: National modelled estimates may differ from local or occupation-specific conditions.
The score is distribution-relative within the 88 valid supported countries.
Antigua and Barbuda and Grenada have no eligible source record; Ukraine is stale.
criteria.description: Harmonised national labour-market conditions derived from employment, labour-force participation and unemployment modelled estimates.
criteria.interpretation: Higher values indicate stronger broad national labour utilisation in the pinned 2025 ILOSTAT modelled estimates. This is occupation-neutral and is not a vacancy, wage, visa-access or city-level jobs measure.
quality_limitations: Employment and participation are related measures, so component redundancy is monitored.
Equal component weights are a transparent product choice, not a publisher weighting.
Future projections included in the source edition are excluded; only the 2025 cross-section is used.

profiles.description: Provisional profile centered on broad relative cost with secondary safety and stability considerations.

profiles.description: Provisional profile emphasizing air quality, safety, equality, institutions, and infrastructure while still considering broad relative cost and immigrant presence.
